reasoning.Student A: Because the mechanism is strategy-proof, my dominant strategy is to report my true preferences. No matter what other students submit (including the common ordering y > x > w > z), misrepresenting my ranking cannot give me a strictly better assignment. Given my true preference y > z > x > w and my priorities (highest at w and y, lower at x and z), truthful reporting already reflects both my values and my comparative chances. Attempting to manipulate by, for example, ranking x or w above y to game the system cannot improve my outcome under a strategy-proof mechanism. Therefore I should (and will) submit my sincere order.
